text: The long baking browns the milk through the Maillard reaction and boils off water, so the milk is already caramel-flavoured and cream-coloured. Thermophilic streptococci then sour it to a mild, thick drink; households seed it with smetana instead.

steps.note: The milk is seeded with smetana, a sour cream, instead of a starter, and a second souring bacterium may join the first.
